name: Asakura Makoto
source: Adaptable and difficult to shock, but in an indifferent rather than collected way. Skilled in speaking diplomatically. The way Tama Indou behaves around her seems almost servile in nature.
translation: Adaptable and difficult to shock, but in an indifferent rather than collected way. Skilled in speaking diplomatically. The way Tama Indou behaves around her seems almost servile in nature.
